title: Who's to blame for a rogue AI? New legal framework maps accountability
description: Cyberattacks and other harms caused by artificial intelligence challenge the ability of laws to determine who is liable. Product liability law would point to the company that built the AI model, but AIs are trained on data the company didn't produce, and the legions of people who have used them also played a role. Free speech and social media immunity laws that treat an AI agent as responsible for its own actions could imply the AI agent deserves the same rights as a person.

title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the artificial intelligence giant at 1.5 trillion
description: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share on Wednesday, according to multiple reports. That amount is above the expected price range and values the artificial intelligence giant at $1.5 trillion. The San Francisco-based maker of the Claude AI tool is set to make its debut Thursday on Wall Street. The company had set a price range of $70 to $78 per share, offering 825 million shares that will begin trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT.
